entries.name: wall.addfacet
entries.description: Add a facet. The proposed facet must share {a vertex in 2D; an edge in 3D} with an existing facet.

entries.name: wall.closed
entries.description: Get the wall closure status. A closed wall is one where all edges are shared.

entries.name: wall.contact.list
entries.description: Get active contacts around a wall. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: wall.contact.list.all
entries.description: Get all contacts around a wall. Inactive contacts are included. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: wall.contactmap
entries.description: Get active contacts around a wall. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: wall.contactmap.all
entries.description: Get all contacts around a wall. Inactive contacts are included. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: wall.contactnum
entries.description: Get number of active contacts around a wall. The optional argument enables filtering by contact type.

entries.name: wall.contactnum.all
entries.description: Get number of contacts around a wall. Inactive contacts are included. The optional argument enables filtering by contact type.

entries.name: wall.convex
entries.description: Get the convexity status. The wall must also be closed to be convex.

entries.name: wall.cutoff
entries.description: Get/set the cutoff angle. The cutoff angle is used during contact resolution to determine whether or not contact state information is propagated.

entries.name: wall.delete
entries.description: Delete a wall.

entries.name: wall.disp
entries.description: Get/set the wall displacement.

entries.name: wall.disp.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the wall displacement.

entries.name: wall.energy
entries.description: Get the wall total energy contribution. This is the sum over all walls of the energy with name s (see the model energy command). eboundary is the available energy.

entries.name: wall.euler
entries.description: Get/set the wall orientation. The convention \big\{X,Y^{'},Z^{''}\big\} is used (i.e., the x-, y- and z-components correspond to the sequential rotations about the X, Y^{'}, and Z^{''} axes).

entries.name: wall.euler.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the wall orientation.

entries.name: wall.extra
entries.description: Get/set wall extra variable.

entries.name: wall.facet.active
entries.description: Get/set the facet activity.

entries.name: wall.facet.contact.list
entries.description: Get active contacts around a facet. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: wall.facet.contact.list.all
entries.description: Get all contacts around a facet. Inactive contacts are included. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: wall.facet.contactmap
entries.description: Get active contacts around a facet. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: wall.facet.contactmap.all
entries.description: Get all contacts around a facet. Inactive contacts are included. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: wall.facet.contactnum
entries.description: Get number of contacts around a facet. The optional argument enables filtering by contact type.

entries.name: wall.facet.contactnum.all
entries.description: Get number of contacts around a facet. Inactive contacts are included. The optional argument enables filtering by contact type.

entries.name: wall.facet.conveyor
entries.description: Get/set the facet conveyor velocity.

entries.name: wall.facet.conveyor.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the facet conveyor velocity.

entries.name: wall.facet.delete
entries.description: Delete a facet. The wall position is automatically updated.

entries.name: wall.facet.extra
entries.description: Get/set facet extra variable.

entries.name: wall.facet.find
entries.description: Find a facet.

entries.name: wall.facet.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to facet f in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: wall.facet.group.list
entries.description: Get a list of facets that belong to the group named s. The arguments s and slot may be specified as strings or indices*. If slot is not specified, then all slots are queried.

entries.name: wall.facet.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the facet in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: wall.facet.groupmap
entries.description: Get facets that belong to a group.

entries.name: wall.facet.id
entries.description: Get the facet ID.

entries.name: wall.facet.inbox
entries.description: Get facets with extents intersecting a box. The extent is the axis-aligned bounding box of the facet. Specifying b = false indicates that only facets with positions falling in the box are returned.

entries.name: wall.facet.isbonded
entries.description: Get the wall facet bonded state. This intrinsic checks the contact models of all active contacts with the wall facet for bonding. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: wall.facet.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the facet and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: wall.facet.isprop
entries.description: Query the existence of a property.

entries.name: wall.facet.list
entries.description: Get the global facet list. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: wall.facet.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum facet ID.

entries.name: wall.facet.near
entries.description: Find the closest facet to a point. If wp is specified, then only facets with this wall are returned. If frad is specified, then the search radius is limited.

entries.name: wall.facet.normal
entries.description: Get the facet normal.

entries.name: wall.facet.normal.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the facet normal.

entries.name: wall.facet.num
entries.description: Get the number of facets.

entries.name: wall.facet.pair
entries.description: Get a neighboring facet. Neighboring facets are those sharing a {vertex in 2D; edge in 3D}. A null pointer can be returned if no neighbor exists.

entries.name: wall.facet.pointnear
entries.description: Get the closest point on the facet to another point.

entries.name: wall.facet.pointnear.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the closest point on the facet to another point.

entries.name: wall.facet.pos
entries.description: Get the facet position.

entries.name: wall.facet.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the facet position.

entries.name: wall.facet.prop
entries.description: Get/set a facet property. The function wall.facet.isprop can be used to assess the existence of a property.

entries.name: wall.facet.typeid
entries.description: Get the facet type number. The typeid can be used to uniquely identify facet FISH pointers from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: wall.facet.vertex
entries.description: Get the facet vertex.

entries.name: wall.facet.wall
entries.description: Get the facet’s wall.

entries.description: Get the facets of a wall. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.description: Get the sum of all contact forces acting on a wall. The resultant force is expressed in the global coordinate system.

entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the wall contact force.

entries.name: wall.inside
